caption.purpose: Metadata; the floor for a figure or a rating.

components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--space-2); } .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 32px; padding: 0 var(--space-3); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-pill); background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); font-family: var(--font); font-size: var(--text-label); font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color var(--dur-1) var(--ease-out), border-color var(--dur-1) var(--ease-out), color var(--dur-1) var(--ease-out); } @media (pointer: coarse) { .ds-chip { min-height: var(--tap); } } @media (hover: hover) { .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--neutral-300); } } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chip.is-on { background: var(--select-bg); border-color: var(--select-border); color: var(--select-ink); font-weight: 600; } .ds-chip svg { flex: none; margin-left: -2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-chip { transition: none; } }

components.name: Segmented
components.description: Two to four exclusive views of one thing; the chosen segment is a lifted white thumb, never a dark fill.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 3px; border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: var(--surface-sunken); } .ds-seg-item { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 38px; padding: 0 var(--space-4); border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: none; color: var(--text-2); font-family: var(--font); font-size: var(--text-label); font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color var(--dur-1) var(--ease-out), color var(--dur-1) var(--ease-out); } @media (pointer: coarse) { .ds-seg-item { min-height: var(--tap); } } @media (hover: hover) { .ds-seg-item:hover:not(.is-on) { color: var(--text); } } .ds-seg-item.is-on { background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); box-shadow: var(--elev-1); } .ds-seg-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 1px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-seg-item { transition: none; } }

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Sections of one page that swap in place; the chosen tab is ink with a 2 px brown underline that grows from the centre.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: var(--space-5); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); } .ds-tab { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: var(--tap); padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--text-2); font-family: var(--font); font-size: var(--text-body); font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: color var(--dur-1) var(--ease-out); } .ds-tab::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: -1px; height: 2px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--action); transform: scaleX(0); transition: transform var(--dur-2) var(--ease-out); } @media (hover: hover) { .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--text); } } .ds-tab.is-on { color: var(--text); } .ds-tab.is-on::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); } .ds-tab-n { color: var(--text-3); font-weight: 500; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-tab, .ds-tab::after { transition: none; } }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A labelled input; the label is always visible, the value is 16 px, focus is the brown ring plus a brown edge.
components.html: Only you see this.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; max-width: 320px; font-family: var(--font); } .ds-field-label { font-size: var(--text-label); font-weight: 600; color: var(--text); } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: var(--tap); padding: 0 var(--space-3); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); font-family: var(--font); font-size: var(--text-lead); transition: border-color var(--dur-1) var(--ease-out); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-3); } @media (hover: hover) { .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--neutral-300); } } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 1px; border-color: var(--action); } .ds-input:disabled { background: var(--surface-sunken); color: var(--text-3); } .ds-field-hint { margin: 0; font-size: var(--text-caption); color: var(--text-3); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-input { transition: none; } }

narrative.overview:
Carta is a travel app you want to open: photos sell the place, and one calm price line sits under every photo, marked as an estimate where it is one. The look is "Lagoon" (T419, owner decision 2026-10-13): the category standard of Airbnb, Polarsteps and Wanderlog, executed at their craft level rather than reinvented. White surfaces sit on a warm light grey; ink is a blue-grey that is never black; one warm brown (umber) carries every action and every selection, so the app has two base colours, the ink and the brown (owner decision 2026-10-13, T438, which replaced the lagoon teal); sun yellow marks best value and nothing else; one friendly typeface, Figtree, sets everything, figures included, with tabular numerals.

The density is a working app, not a brochure. A filtered or searched list on Explore and Destinations is compact rows, about ten to a phone screen, each a small rounded photo, a name, the Score and a price line such as "€49 a day". Sections (rails) and the home page use large photo tiles, where inspiration leads. Pages say less: no catalogue counts, no method or coverage sentences beside a figure (owner, 2026-10-13). Depth is quiet: objects at rest carry a hairline border, and only what floats (a sheet, a popover, a control over a photograph) takes a soft ink shadow.

The world refuses two things, both confirmed by the owner in the direction contract (`continent-app/.impeccable/surfaces/continent-app.md`): the brochure hero with text laid over a photograph, and the dark instrument look of black slabs and dark selected states.
keyCharacteristics: Photography leads; text never sits on a photograph.
Two base colours: blue-grey ink and one brown for everything that acts or is selected, as a light tint plus brown text, never a dark slab.
A rating is the Score: a brown star and an ink figure, never a filled chip.
Every colour outside the neutrals and the brown has exactly one job.
One typeface, tabular figures everywhere, so prices line up and settle in place.
Borders at rest, shadows only on what floats.
Every control is 44 px on touch, with a 2 px brown focus ring.

rules.name: The Two Colours Rule
rules.body: Ink carries the text and the drawings; brown means it acts, is live or is selected. Nothing decorative and no status is ever brown; the rating star and the gem diamond are the two small marks it lends out.

rules.name: The One Job Rule
rules.body: Sun yellow is best value, red destruction, rust a warning. A colour borrowed for a second job stops meaning the first.

rules.name: The No Slab Rule
rules.body: A selected state is the light brown tint with a brown label and a mark (a tick, an underline, a lifted thumb). Never a dark fill, so the app never reads as black.

rules.name: The Floor Rule
rules.body: Nothing functional is set under 11 px, and no figure or rating under 12 px. T421 raised every rule that was under 10 px; the older per-screen files still hold px sizes from 10 px up, which the migration moves onto the scale.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every column of figures uses tabular numerals in the one family. A figure that changes updates in place, never with a count-up.

rules.name: The Compact Default Rule
rules.body: Lists where places are compared default to compact rows (about ten to a phone screen); large photo tiles belong to rails and the home page.

rules.name: The Border Or Shadow Rule
rules.body: Elevation is declared once per object: a border or a shadow, never both.

dos: **Do** read a role (`--action`, `--surface`, `--text-3`) in every new or touched rule, and build from the kit in `src/components/ui/`.
**Do** keep one primary Button per view; everything else is secondary or quiet.
**Do** show selection as `--select-bg` with `--select-ink` and a mark: a tick on a chip, an underline on a tab, a lifted thumb on a segment.
**Do** put a caption under a photograph, never on it.
**Do** give every control a 44 px (`--tap`) target on touch and the 2 px `--focus` ring on `:focus-visible`.
**Do** print every euro through `formatMoney()` or `<Money>`: whole euros where places are compared, cents on receipts and totals, `~€87 est.` for an estimate.
**Do** declare elevation once: a `--border` at rest, or an `--elev-*` shadow on what floats.
**Do** take every duration and easing from the motion tokens and give every transition a reduced-motion branch.
donts: **Don't** paint a selected state as a dark fill; the dark slab is the look Lagoon refused.
**Don't** use brown for anything that does not act, is not live or is not selected (beyond the rating star and the gem diamond), or sun yellow, rust or red outside their one job.
**Don't** fill a rating chip, show a catalogue count as page furniture, or put a method or coverage sentence beside a figure.
**Don't** set sun yellow as text; best value as text is ink beside the marker.
**Don't** add a gradient, a second typeface, a monospaced face for figures, or a hex outside `01-tokens.css` and the token mirror.
**Don't** set functional text under 11 px, or a figure or rating under 12 px.
**Don't** give one object both a border and a shadow.
**Don't** write a euro sign into an i18n string, call `toFixed` on a price, or round a figure on a receipt.
**Don't** use a placeholder as the only name of a field.
**Don't** write em dashes, en dashes, middots or bullet characters as separators in any copy.
